September 23, 2024
Claim opened on a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind. The claimant is
represented by a lawyer, and all contact is to go through counsel from here on.
November 1, 2024
The rear damage to the claimant's vehicle matches the impact as described. No secne photos have been submitted
by anyone, and no other report of the collision has been located.
December 4, 2024
The police record confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. No witnesses have come forward to describe
the collision itself.
December 28, 2024
The driver is named on the policy and is confirmed as the operator. Inspection and prior claim records show no earlier
damage to the vehicle, and nothing suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
February 13, 2025
The claimant reports a wrist fracture, and the injury fits the force expected from a rear impact. No earlier injury to the
same body area is known from the records gathered so far.
March 8, 2025
Treatment has grown to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits. New body areas were
added to the claim several weeks after the collision.
April 2, 2025
The claimant's account has stayed the same in every conversation, including the recorded statement and the
discussion with counsel. Requested complete prior medical records and noted the treatment pattern for the medical
review team.
April 4, 2025
File remains open pending the medical review and any independent confirmation of the collision itself.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
